v4.6.11 — Universe tab init-order fix + build pipeline hardening

🐛 FIXED
• UniverseTab crashed on app start with 'AttributeError: _desc_lbl'. _populate_script_combo was called BEFORE the description QLabel it tries to update was instantiated. Moved label creation up the init order + added a defensive try/except in _on_script_changed.
• Build pipeline could ship a fresh version.json paired with STALE module bytecode when two PyInstaller runs collided (one held build/APEX/APEX.exe locked, the other silently fell back to cached .pyc). embed_version.py now nukes BOTH dist/APEX/ AND build/APEX/ before every build, and warns loudly if either can't be deleted. This is the structural fix for the 'v4.6.10 says no attribute _populate_script_combo even though source has it' class of bug.
